name: model-router
description: Pick the model and effort for the main agent and, separately, for its subagents; cap how many run at once and put the main agent in orchestrator mode.

subModel.title: Subagent model
subModel.description: The model subagents run on when a model of their own is enabled.

subEnabled.title: Subagent model on
subEnabled.description: Start sessions with a separate subagent model enabled.

maxSubagents.title: Max subagents
maxSubagents.description: How many subagents may run at once; 0 for no cap.

orchestrator.title: Orchestrator mode
orchestrator.description: Tell the main agent to plan, delegate and review instead of doing the heavy work.
